title: Deloitte Innovation Hub I Senior Power Platform Developer, Intelligent Automation, Cairo, Egypt
description: Power Platform Developer, Intelligent Automation, CairoConnect to your career at DeloitteDeloitte, established globally in 1845, is the world’s largest and leading professional services firm, providing Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal and Consulting and related services to public and private clients spanning multiple industries. Present in more than 150 countries, Deloitte is distinct in its ability to help clients solve their most complex problems, from strategy to implementation.Deloitte innovation hub (DIH) is a strategic initiative established to support our ambition to become the leading business transformation partner of choice for our clients and to expand and scale our delivery footprint across EMEA. With access to a scaled, diverse, highly skilled, motivated, and engaged workforce, DIH is delivering complex technical solutions for clients’ most complex business problems, across portfolios that include ‘Strategy & Transactions’, ‘Customer’, ‘Engineering, AI & Data, ‘Enterprise, Technology & Performance’ and ‘Cyber’. DIH is aiming to become the destination for top talents in Egypt for a long, exciting career.We invest in outstanding people of diverse talents and backgrounds and empower them to achieve more than they could elsewhere. Our work combines advice with action and integrity. We believe that when our clients and society are stronger, so are we. Our organization has grown in scale and diversity, providing services across the region, with our shared culture remaining the same. We aim to help clients realize their ambitions, make a positive difference in society, and maximize the success of our people. This drive fuels the commitment and humanity that run deep through our every action.Your opportunityInterested in joining our exciting and thriving Intelligent Automation practice?We are recruiting Microsoft 365, Power Platform & Dynamics Consultants, specialising in intelligent automation and low code application development to join our team in Cairo.This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team which has been identified as a critical element of Deloitte’s next generation service provision. Demand for our services is higher than ever and we need experienced people who will grow and succeed with us.You will be part of a diverse and strategically important team that focuses principally on implementing robotic and cognitive technology solutions to replicate human actions and mimic human judgement, to help our Clients improve workforce quality, speed and productivity. Working alongside colleagues from across the across the globe, Deloitte is an environment where you and your career can flourish.The Intelligent Automation team focuses principally on implementing automation, cloud and artificial intelligence solutions to replicate human actions and mimic human judgement, to help our clients improve workforce quality, speed and productivity. We are looking to grow this high-demand and high-impact team, to help our clients address their greatest challenges. We offer opportunities for exciting and innovative work with clients across multiple sectors and with leading technologies, skills acquisition and professional knowledge growth.We need the very best people to join us and that is where you come in!Your roleAs part of this team you would be working principally with Microsoft Power Platform applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI & Power Virtual Agents), Office 365, Azure and Dynamics, to address the challenges and automation ambitions of our clients and deliver results. As a Developer within this team, you have the opportunity to develop your career while working with multiple clients across all major industries in an innovative and dynamic environment.As a Developer within our Intelligent Automation practice, your role will involve:Working with our clients to understand the opportunity for automation within their organisation, and developing automation strategies, embedding principles, crafting roadmaps and business casesEngaging in both advisory and implementation projects, from helping clients with their wider transformation strategies, to supporting the full lifecycle of delivery projects of Design, Develop, Pilot, Deploy, Test, RunUnderstanding, evaluating, and re-imagining end-to-end processes within publicly sensitivity operations factored in, enabling the successful translation of automation needs into clear requirements for automation purposesUndertaking requirements gathering (both process and technical), client interviewing, documentation of processes and process assessmentWorking with stakeholders at all levels including senior stakeholders and across the Client, Deloitte and third parties (including software vendors)Understanding the importance of stakeholder and change management and incorporating it into the implementation of automation strategiesWorking effectively within inclusive and diverse teams within where people are recognised for their contribution, and actively supporting the development of individuals and teams, both formally and informallyYour work, your choiceAt Deloitte we believe the best impact is the value we add, not the hours we sit at our desk. We, therefore, carefully consider agile ways of working, both formal and informal, that allow for the best impact for our people and our clients. If the working pattern you are looking for is not specifically indicated below, we are happy to discuss alternative arrangements.Location: Cairo, with domestic and international travel per your clients’ requirementsSuggested work pattern: This is a permanent full-time opportunity, with a travel requirement, but with the opportunity to benefit from the Firm’s agile working practices.Your Technical ExperienceWe expect you to have skills and experience in the following:3 -7 years of developer experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents), or Dynamics 365Experience with Canvas, Model Driven and Portal appsMicrosoft certified in one or more of the following:PL-900 – Power Platform FundamentalsPL-100 – Power Platform App Maker AssociatePL-200 – Power Platform Functional Consultant AssociateMB-910 - Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (CRM)MB-920 Dynamics 365 Fundamentals Finance and Operations Apps (ERP)Experience with Microsoft Office 365 including SharePoint and TeamsExperience with Microsoft Azure products and services including Azure Logic Apps and the Azure AI PlatformExperience with Dataverse (Common Data Service) and SQLExperience in HTML, Power FX and developing custom connectorsExperience creating managed and unmanaged solutionsKnowledge of how to interact with REST APIs and formats (JSON)Experience working with agile and iterative delivery methodsAbility to analyse, understand business problems and document in a detailed design documentProficiency in MS Office (Access, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) including macros creationThe following will be an added advantage:Internal or external consultancy experienceTechnical university degreeIn-depth knowledge of alternative automation technologies / vendors such as Automation Anywhere, Be Informed, Blue Prism, NICE and UiPathIn-depth knowledge of alternative low code technologies / vendors such as Appian, Outsystems and PegaExperience with cloud computing platform such as Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and their cognitive serviceYour Professional ExperienceWe are looking for a blend of business and technical skillsets. As such, to be successful you are required to:Have a keen interest in intelligent automation, Microsoft, cloud-based technology and its implications for our clients’ organisationDemonstrate an understanding of IA, familiarity with Microsoft technology and any of the key vendor platforms, and a clear understanding of the direction of travel in the marketHave experience in delivering IA programmes from opportunity identification, to live deployment and hyper-careDemonstrate knowledge of process improvement, process design, business process mapping and experience in delivering end-to-end process reviewsDemonstrate experience managing complex stakeholder environments and relationshipsPossess good problem solving and analytical skillsDemonstrate an ability to problem-solve in a creative mannerBe comfortable working within an agile delivery environmentWork effectively within an inclusive team and actively support the development of individuals and teams, both formally and informallyCore Consulting SkillsWe expect that you possess the following core consulting skills:A "can do" attitude; a hands-on and flexible approach to emerging requirements and a real willingness to learn and participateGood communication, presentation, and people skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas, technical and process conversations to different audiences within an organisationStrong problem solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to exercise mature judgment and escalate as appropriateExperience of working in fast-paced and demanding delivery-focused environments, with ability to stay calm under pressureUnderstanding and awareness of the commercial and reputational risks Deloitte may encounter and the appropriate mitigations Connect to your service line - Technology and TransformationDistinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.Personal independenceRegulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to several audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process.Connect to your Industry“What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Deloitte’s clients include many of the world’s largest organizations; I wanted to be part of a team that made a difference that I could be proud of.” -Dan, Consulting Our commitment to youMaking an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So, we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective, and personality. So, we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.Connect to your next stepA career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level. reason: Strong match on intelligent automation, LLM/orchestration, workflow design, integrations, and client-facing delivery, which align well with Deloitte’s automation practice. Main gaps are explicit Microsoft Power Platform/Dynamics depth and the more enterprise/consulting-heavy seniority expectations, though the remote setup and UTC+1 location fit well.
